news.headline: Tulane practices on grass to get ready for Duke
news.summary: The Green Wave held their last tune-up practice Friday at the Saints facility so they could work on a real grass field. Duke's stadium has grass, and Tulane opens there on September 5.

news.headline: Zeon Chriss-Gremillion will start at quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall picked Chriss-Gremillion to start Tulane's opener at Duke on September 5. He has started 13 college games, first at Louisiana and then at Houston.

news.headline: Two quarterbacks lead the way in last scrimmage
news.summary: Kadin Semonza and Zeon Chriss-Gremillion took most of the first-team snaps in Tulane's final scrimmage on Saturday at Yulman Stadium. Coach Will Hall said he will name his starting quarterback on Monday.

news.headline: Florida's opener Saturday is sold out
news.summary: Florida says every seat is taken for the Florida Atlantic game. It is the 19th home game in a row that has sold out.

news.headline: Florida is healthy going into Saturday's opener
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Tuesday that the Gators are pretty healthy and almost everyone is ready to play. Walk-on running back Kelvin Jimenez is out for the year, and tight end Evan Chieca is questionable.

news.headline: Florida posts its first lineup chart of the year
news.summary: The Gators listed their starters Monday for Saturday's opener against Florida Atlantic. Aaron Philo is the quarterback and Jadan Baugh is the running back, while three players are still competing for the last spot on the defensive line.

news.headline: Trevor Goosby will play in Saturday's opener
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Thursday that his left tackle is good to go after a bruised knee. Texas will watch how many plays he takes because it will be hot on Saturday afternoon.

news.headline: Four Texas home games move up a week
news.summary: Texas said four future home games will now be played a week earlier, starting with New Mexico State on August 28, 2027. College football will begin a week sooner from next season on.

news.headline: Arch Manning signs a trading card deal with Topps
news.summary: Arch Manning agreed to let Topps make his trading cards and sign autographs for them. His first Topps cards will be in the new Bowman football set.

news.headline: Saints let go of two hurt players
news.summary: The Saints released running back Devin Neal and pass rusher Michael Heldman, who were both hurt in the preseason. The team paid them for their recovery time, and it can sign them again later.

news.headline: Saints claim a cornerback off waivers
news.summary: New Orleans picked up cornerback Decamerion Richardson from Las Vegas on Wednesday. Safety Lorenzo Styles Jr. went on injured reserve, and wide receiver Kevin Austin Jr. and tight end Treyton Welch joined the practice squad.

news.headline: Kamara and Cameron Jordan miss practice this week
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said Tuesday that running back Alvin Kamara and defensive end Cameron Jordan are not expected to practice this week. Moore said he will know more about them at the end of next week.

news.headline: IUP sweeps West Liberty to open its home tournament
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-23, 25-21 and 25-15 on Friday at the Kovalchick Complex. It was their first home match of the year and made their record 3-3.

news.headline: IUP beats Wayne State to close the tournament
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 24-26, 25-22, 25-22, 25-20 on Saturday in Detroit. Sammy Stephens had a career-best 14 kills and Charlotte Potvin served five aces.

news.headline: Quincy beats IUP in four sets
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won the first set 25-17 on Saturday morning in Detroit and then lost the next three. Delaney Concannon led IUP with 13 kills and Brooke Kessler had 12 digs.

news.headline: Yankees win in extra innings in Anaheim
news.summary: New York scored five runs with two outs in the 10th inning Wednesday night and beat the Angels 6-3. Cam Schlittler pitched eight innings and gave up just one run.

news.headline: Yankees beat Angels 7-3
news.summary: New York hit two home runs in a row in the first inning Tuesday night in Anaheim. Spencer Jones and Jazz Chisholm Jr. hit them, and Gerrit Cole gave up one run in five innings.

news.headline: Ryan McMahon comes off the injured list
news.summary: The Yankees put their third baseman back on the roster Tuesday after he hurt his left thumb two weeks ago. Relief pitcher John Schreiber joined the active roster the same day.
